summary.text: Gregg Lindner is the Democratic candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 4 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Dan Zitofsky in a race with no incumbent.
A retired executive who was president of the Americas for GfK/MRI Simmons, he ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Gregg Lindner was born in New York, graduated from Wooton High School, and earned a graduate degree from the University of Maryland in 1980.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Lindner said his graduate degree was in quantitative analysis and that his career of more than 30 years was in media and marketing research, finishing as president of the Americas for GfK/MRI Simmons.

He said he served as a school board member while holding that post, and that he currently sits on a local school board citizens financial oversight board and serves as a homeowners' association president.
Lindner was the Democratic nominee for District 4 in 2024, when Republican incumbent Jeff Hilovsky defeated him 58.0% to 42.0%.

In the survey, Lindner said he would focus on infrastructure pressures from rapid growth in the district, on affordability including energy and housing costs, and on opposing data centers that use scarce water resources.
He named education funding as a policy interest, citing his school board and business experience.
